title: Osun Grove Festival Pavilion
note: The geotagged 2022 portrait shows the west relief and the stage edge. The selected photo fit faces about 194 degrees true. Its model center is shifted 4 m north from the fixed-scale fit, within the recorded 4.7 m GPS uncertainty. Both photographic bearings remain within one degree and the pavilion clears First Palace by about 6 m. The 2020 map marks the pavilion about 26 m away. That marker disagrees with the photographed approach when treated as a building center. Canopy obscures both roof positions in aerial imagery. The exact footing, bearing and hillside remain approximate.
